{{Quote|There's nothing on the southern continent?''"<br />"''Nothing but a civil war. Been going on for the past ten years.|[[Korlo Brightwater]] and [[Saberan Marcross]]|<ref name="Allegiance (novel)">[[Allegiance (novel)|''Allegiance'']]</ref>}}
The '''South Cont's civil war''' was a [[civil war]] taking place on the southern continent of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ranklinge]]. The northern continent, which was the location of the most important cities of the planet, was spared from the conflict.

After two years of war, the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] sent a couple of [[Diplomat/Legends|diplomats]] in [[8 BBY/Legends|8 BBY]] to mediate the conflict. They didn't managed to solve the war and all Imperial forces eventually left the planet. The civil war was not ended in the months following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].
